renethack's game engine: the complete source
=============================================

This is the source of the programs in the game's engine/ folder (nh-engine,
recover) and of the data files beside them, under the NetHack General Public
License (engine/upstream/dat/license).

engine/upstream/   NetHack 5.0.0 as released (the commit the game was built
                   from), unchanged.
engine/patches/    renethack's changes to NetHack, applied at build time in
                   the order of engine/patches/series; each says what it
                   changes and why.
engine/host/       the protocol host the engine is linked with (nh-engine's
                   main, the window port that speaks to the game).
engine/runtime/    the sysconf file the game ships.
engine/Makefile    the build.
lua-*/             the Lua release NetHack's build links (MIT licence).

To build on macOS or Linux (a C compiler, GNU make, patch, git, curl):

    cd engine/upstream && git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm src && cd ../..
    make -C engine

The first line only makes engine/upstream a git checkout, which the build
exports from. The build downloads the Lua release from lua.org and checks
its sha256; offline, run `make -C engine build/tree/.patched` first, copy
lua-*/ into engine/build/tree/lib/, then `make -C engine`. engine/build/
then holds nh-engine, recover and data/.
